classification: Judgment only; documented repository standards override this baseline. Tool-enforced formatting/type/lint issues are excluded.

judgments.Mysterious Name: No actionable name issue. The response-origin ambiguity is resolved by excluding the shared parser code, and displayName documents its actual presentation/default-name purpose.
judgments.Duplicated Code: The shared pre-mutation classifier is extracted for three consumers. Format-specific GeoJSON and profile interpretation remain separate. No unrelated generic import framework is required by these hunks.
judgments.Feature Envy: Plane construction stays with geometryEditing; transaction ownership stays with GeometryImportStore; the UI consumes their typed operations.
judgments.Data Clumps: GeoJsonChoice, GeometryImportIntent and GeometryImportOptions name the actual travelling aggregates. The hook owns project/session context.
judgments.Primitive Obsession: Exact body/key remain necessary immutable transport values; the named source/choice/options/intent types describe their domain context. The label cap is a documented UI code-point policy, not an engineering number.
judgments.Repeated Switches: The error code/status policy is in one map; the small export label/option branches serve their local UI. No additional actionable repeated dispatch structure.
judgments.Shotgun Surgery: Changes cross expected feature seams: domain input, durable journal, hook, UI, translation and native styles. No single unrelated policy requires scattered manual rewrites.
judgments.Divergent Change: Store, parsing/choices, plane math, frozen settings, fields and intake controller have separate modules. No line-count criterion is imposed.
judgments.Speculative Generality: The injected journal seam is exercised by actual storage-failure tests; recovery scopes, immutable settings and original candidates are current requirements.
judgments.Message Chains: The schema-shaped original/asset metadata access is bounded by validators and named prepared types. No additional actionable chain was found.
judgments.Middle Man: acknowledge/clear expose distinct safe journal operations around the private transactional change helper. roofPlane is shared computation, not a pointless pass-through.
judgments.Refused Bequest: No added inheritance or discarded inherited contract. IDBFactory is used by composition as a test dependency.
